candidates.computation_change_reason: This conditional establishes two alternative mercury MQL values (0.005 vs 0.0005 µg/l) depending on whether Part I requires Method 1631. Resolving that condition changes the mercury quantitation floor (affecting exceedance determinations), whether the more sensitive monitoring method is required, and how mercury results reported at or below detection should be classified when no ordinary numeric result is available.
